column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” as “A Psalm of David,” and “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַשְׂכִּילָה (“give heed”) is rendered “I will behave wisely,” and “blameless… integrity of heart” “perfect… perfect heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a thing of Belial” is rendered “nothing wicked,” and “the doing of swerving deeds” “the work of those who fall away.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wide of heart” is rendered “a proud heart,” and “I will not be able” “I will not endure.”
Close to the Hebrew; “blameless” is rendered “perfect.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the mornings” is rendered “Early.”
